task: A direct follow-up on the just-shipped World Builder reuse-picker layout fix, delivered against the exact same class of defect one screen over in root Studio: 'from this world section in studio will also need to be presented in better manner.' js/contextPanel.js's Personalize->Add Something->'From This World' browsing surface (Collection Phase 6, root Studio's Creator-facing consumer of availableToCreator Collection assets) had the identical unbounded-grid defect as World Builder's own reuse picker -- _showCollectionPicker()'s tile grid was a plain display:grid with no height cap, sitting inline inside the right sidebar's Context Inspector, growing taller with every availableToCreator asset a Theme Author flags. Fix, this time mirroring root Studio's own already-polished horizontal-scroll precedent rather than World Builder's own -- js/objectStrip.js's already-proven 'this scroll can be better' pattern (css/style.css's .object-strip-scroll-row/-arrow/-list): round arrow buttons + a soft edge-fade mask over a real, native overflow-x:auto scroll, instead of the plain unadorned strip World Builder uses. _showCollectionPicker() now builds a .context-collection-picker-row (arrow buttons flanking a masked .context-collection-picker-wrap) wrapping the rewritten .context-collection-picker-grid (display:flex; overflow-x:auto instead of display:grid), with .context-collection-tile changed from a grid cell to a fixed-width flex:0 0 auto card matching .object-card's own established 78px width exactly. Built entirely fresh each time the picker opens -- the arrow click handlers and scroll-position listener close over local list/prevBtn/nextBtn variables, mirroring js/objectStrip.js's own _wireScrollArrows() shape including its identical 8px scroll-snap-settling tolerance for the arrow-disabled-state check. _activeCollectionAssets()/_addCollectionObject() and every field name/class the picker's own tiles carry are completely unchanged -- a pure layout rewrite of the container, not a behaviour change. Verified via a new, dedicated Playwright suite (collection_creator_layout_verify.js, scratch-only, 17/17 assertions, zero unexpected console/page errors) seeding two synthetic artwork themes directly into localStorage's vihu.themeRegistry.imported.v1 key (2 and 10 availableToCreator entries respectively, in separate browser contexts) and driving the real UI end to end through Creation Flow->Workspace->Personalize->Add Something->From This World: confirms the strip is genuinely overflow-x:auto (not a grid) with real horizontal overflow at 10 entries, every tile still resolves a real data: URI thumbnail exactly as before, and -- the decisive proof -- the picker's own measured height with 10 entries is byte-identical to its height with 2 entries, plus a genuine arrow-button-click scroll test confirming Next actually moves scrollLeft and Prev correctly enables/disables at the strip's own true start. The pre-existing collection_phase6_verify.js regression suite needed zero changes at all -- its own selectors were never renamed, only the container's own display/overflow behaviour changed -- re-verified 13/13 passing unchanged. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Builder architecture change; tools/world-builder-v2/ and tools/world-builder/ (v1) are both completely untouched -- confined entirely to js/contextPanel.js and css/style.css.
